verdict.rationale: Okta's own docs refer to its Admin Management APIs, which its official MCP server wraps for user, group, app and log operations. A rate-limits reference page and the free Integrator plan for 'manage and automate Okta' show a documented public API that programs and agents can drive. Missing for 10: a direct API reference page in the evidence, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
